name: Smokey Lentil and Tomato Soup with Olives

cookSteps.description: Slice onion, mince garlic, chop olives
ingredients: ¾ cup (115 g) pitted Kalamata olives, roughly chopped

cookSteps.description: Sauté onion with oil and salt until translucent
Add garlic and thyme; cook 30 seconds
Add paprika, lentils, broth, salt, pepper; bring to boil
ingredients: 2 tbsp sweet smoked paprika (hot smoked works but is spicy; start with 1 tbsp)
1 cup (190 g) brown or green lentils

cookSteps.description: Simmer covered until lentils are almost tender
Add tomatoes; return to boil then simmer until tender
ingredients: 1 (24-oz / 680 g) can stewed tomatoes, fire-roasted if you can find them

cookSteps.description: Stir in spinach and olives until spinach wilts
ingredients: 4 cups (80 g) loosely packed baby spinach or chopped spinach
